name: hermes-excel-sidecar
description: Installable Hermes plugin providing a local Office.js task pane and authenticated Excel bridge.

scripts.check:install: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install/check.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File test/rollback-processes.ps1
scripts.check:syntax: node --check broker/server.mjs && node --check broker/formula-rebase.mjs && node --check taskpane.js && node --check scripts/verify-release-ancestry.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-release-metadata.mjs && python -m compileall -q __init__.py adapter.py cli.py excel_policy.py excel_runtime.py excel_tool.py profile_ownership.py broker/local_extract.py scripts/check_dco.py
scripts.check:plugin: node --test test/plugin-package.test.mjs test/release-ancestry.test.mjs && python -m unittest discover -s test -p test_*.py
scripts.validate: npm test && npm run check:syntax && npm run check:plugin && npm run check:install && npm run check:release
